title: Prefactorization algebras for the conformal Laplacian: Central charge and Hilbert Fock space
summary: Let $d \geq 2$. We consider the symmetric monoidal category of oriented Riemannian $d$-manifolds with conformal open embeddings. The prefactorization algebra associated with the conformal Laplacian defines a symmetric monoidal functor from this category to real vector spaces. For Euclidean domains $U\subset\mathbb{R}^d$, the value of this functor is identified, via the Green function, with the symmetric algebra on the topological dual of the space of harmonic functions.
